title: Revalidate demo media before inheriting its prior full-decode result
rationale: The recording and exported film pass verified_decode without expected_hash. The demo JSON has no media digest, while copy_video skips ffmpeg whenever verified_decode is supplied and only compares the copied file with the current source. If either source is changed or its payload is corrupted after the PASS demo, ffprobe can still read its metadata and duration; this path then emits fullDecodeExitCode=0 and a PASS report without establishing that the delivered bytes are the previously decoded bytes. Official samples correctly avoid this gap by supplying an expected SHA-256. This is a report evidence integrity weakness; the review does not assert that the current demo files are corrupt.
suggestion: Run full decode for the recording and film delivery copies, or persist their SHA-256 values when the demo validates them and require those digests before reusing full-decode evidence. Update the report wording to match the resulting verification.
